qa_pairs.question: What is being tested in test step 06?
qa_pairs.answer: Control unit/simulation - front wheels, specifically testing voltage between wires 1 and 10 for left and right pressure solenoids during build-up, drop, and hold phases.

qa_pairs.question: What should I do if the solenoid pressure build-up, drop, or hold phases fail during testing?
qa_pairs.answer: Turn on ignition, run engine, and ensure battery is charged. Due to high switching on power, possibly repeat test with engine running. Replace control unit and repeat test step.

qa_pairs.question: What are the job position codes for replacing the control unit and hydraulic unit?
qa_pairs.answer: Control unit replacement is job position 34 52 510, and hydraulic unit replacement is job position 34 51 520.

qa_pairs.question: What additional troubleshooting step should I take if valves in test steps 08, 09 and 10 do not switch or pump does not run?
Why might the pressure building-up and pressure holding phases only be checkable on 325 iX cars?
qa_pairs.answer: Only the pressure building-up and pressure holding phases (2 A) can be checked in 325 iX cars because of the changed activation times in the control unit. Irregular values will be displayed on adapter B in switch position (5 A).

qa_pairs.question: When might it be necessary to repeat this test step?
qa_pairs.answer: It might be necessary to repeat this test step to reach the nominal values due to the high switching-on power and short switching phase.

qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual am I looking at?
qa_pairs.answer: This is page 34-40 from Group 34 (Brakes section) of the service manual.

qa_pairs.question: What preliminary steps are required before testing the solenoid voltages?
qa_pairs.answer: Turn on ignition, run engine, and ensure battery is charged (check).

qa_pairs.question: What is the recommended approach when high switching power might affect test results?
qa_pairs.answer: Due to high switching on power, possibly repeat test with engine running, and replace control unit and repeat test step if needed.

qa_pairs.question: Which specific wires are being tested for voltage in this control unit simulation test?
qa_pairs.answer: Voltage between wires 1 and 10 is being tested for both left and right pressure solenoids.
